transcript.text: I was talking to a world champion, and I
texted him out of the blue cuz I woke up
thinking about him. And I was like,
"Hey, man, I just want you to know I
think you should just win this next
championship and cut it. Leave on top.
Leave with people being like, 'Man, he
could take it again the next year if he
wanted to, but he chose not to cuz he's
above the game.'" And he responded by
saying, "Well, what about the lessons
you learn from losing?" And that answer
pissed me off so much because losing
only teaches one lesson, which is to
avoid it. He became a champion by losing
first and learning to avoid it, which
made him champion. And so, trying to
relearn the lessons of loss is like
saying, "I want to go down two levels to
learn to beat the same boss again." But
you already beat that boss, and you
already moved on from it.
